manage_turns_body_break: The next range did not begin where the last one ended, so the text was not joined.
manage_turns_body_reclaimed: {count} temporary stream paths were reclaimed; the text says so where they were.
manage_turns_body_stopped: This range stopped short of the end, and the face named no next range to read.
manage_turns_body_wrong_message: This range belongs to a different message than the one on screen, so it is not shown.
manage_turns_break_message: Paused this turn · wakes on the next message
manage_turns_break_timer: Paused this turn · wakes on a message or after about {minutes} min
manage_turns_break_unrecorded: Paused this turn · the record does not say how this turn wakes
manage_turns_break_wait: Paused this turn · wakes on a message or its own timer
manage_turns_fallback_shown: This record does not match the layout this tool has; the generic layout follows.
manage_turns_load_failed: Could not load the turn history.
manage_turns_no_log: No turn history found for this agent.
manage_turns_open_hint: Messages and tool calls for every turn this agent recorded.
manage_turns_page_cut: This page stopped at its size cap; older turns are still below.
manage_turns_reasoning_unavailable: This record kept a reasoning flag but no text.
manage_turns_schema_face: The turn history schema version does not match the server's; cannot display.
manage_turns_streams_pending: This result has not been read to the end yet; its layout is decided once the whole text is here.
manage_turns_streams_unknown: This result left no output stream to display; the raw text follows.
manage_turns_text_as_kept: This text did not parse into a terminal record, so it is shown raw.
manage_turns_text_too_large: This text is too large to lay out as a tree, so it is shown raw.
manage_turns_text_unsafe_number: This text holds a number that cannot be shown exactly, so it is shown raw.
manage_turns_turn_empty: This turn recorded no messages and no tool calls.
manage_turns_usage_line: prompt {prompt} · completion {completion} · cache read {cacheRead} · cache write {cacheWrite} · reasoning {reasoning}
manage_turns_break_timer_seconds: Paused this turn · wakes on a message or after about {seconds} s
manage_turns_bg_stalled: This task appears to be waiting on an interactive prompt that will not answer.
manage_turns_bg_tail: These are the latest lines the task kept; earlier output is not in this read.
manage_turns_evict_line: Evicted {evicted} of {total} unpinned turns · freed {freed} tokens
manage_turns_evict_kept: Kept {keptTurns} turns, within caps of {maxTurns} turns and {maxTokens} tokens
manage_turns_evict_cap_zero: The turn cap is 0, so every turn was condensed.
manage_turns_evict_degraded: The token slice kept no turn: {reason}
manage_turns_pending_hint: Nothing runs until approval_commit is called with this id and a reason; approval_cancel drops it.
manage_turns_bad_lines_one: One line could not be read while loading these turns.
manage_turns_bad_lines_other: {count} lines could not be read while loading these turns.
